title: Founder Voice
description: Write in the voice of an aspiring founder telling the story of what they're building - terse, concrete, unpolished, not corporate-brochure prose. Strong for founder's notes, About and welcome pages, project and product intros, and for explaining a technical idea through a plain everyday mental model. Generalized from a personal writing-voice skill (upstream: github.com/0xwolfk/write-like-adam); carries no personal identity.
